Apr 5 Bloodhounds Season 2 is a fast, action-packed race from start to finish. Yet, throughout the course of the season’s run, it never quite matches up to the same stakes or intensity of its predecessor. "The hero is sad that he has to hurt people, even terrible gangsters, and his coach/friend wants them to work together...Then, a bunch of people hit each other hundreds of times....The entire series could have been 20 minutes long. The first season had suspense, good acting, and interesting characters. This one was written by teenagers....Pass. Everything is perfect, the act, the plot and the actors. 🤩🤩 Pray for season 3, it must be. 🤞🤞❤❤❤ See more Christonia B. @RT19756889 1d 10/10 acting the fighting choreography everything perfect anyone out there looking to watch bloodhound give it ago Zakyjha M. @RT00952664 2d I loved it, the actors did an amazing job with the series it's filled with lots of action and anticipation. I love you can feel the weight of their past experiences in every interaction it's not about the fight it's about who their fighting for. See more Dale G @RT37444244 2d The second season kept me out of my seat I just couldn’t stop watching. So much action packed fighting. Fast paced. Absolutely loved it! It is a much watch series just can’t get enough. Can’t wait for a third season! See more Lizeth C @Lizrodam 3d I’m loving season two, it really pulls at your emotions through Geon Woo. He’s such a powerful actor that you feel everything right along with him. Woo Jin is also a great supporting character fun, engaging, and overall excellent acting from him too. There are a few loose ends I’d love to see resolved, but hopefully they’ll be addressed in the next season. Overall, compared to the first season, this one has more action and a stronger storyline across all seven episodes. It keeps you guessing, and I’m honestly enjoying it even more than the first. Finally, a drama-action series this year that truly delivers.
